title: Erdős 1172: GCH ordinal partition relations on ω₂ and ω₃ and huge-cardinal consistency of ω₂ → (ω₁ + ω)²₂
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of Parts (ii), (iii), and (iv) of Erdős Problem 1172. Parts (ii) and (iii) are new mathematical results proved in ZFC + GCH (Cardinal.GCH): ω₃ → (ω₂ + ω₁, ω₂ + ω)² and ω₂ → (ω₁^(ω + 2) + 2, ω₁ + 2)², matching Baumgartner, Hajnal, and Todorčević (1993, p. 2) and the 1999 Budapest problem booklet [Va99, 7.87] verbatim, both previously open in the set-theory literature. Part (iv) gives the first formalization of the known relative consistency result (Laver 1982; Foreman-Hajnal 2003) for the ω₁ + ω case posed by Erdős and Hajnal (1974, p. 272): relative to a huge cardinal κ with target θ (IsHugeWithTarget κ θ, Kanamori Theorem 24.8) and ground GCH at and above θ, the first-order theory ZFC + GCH + ω₂ → (ω₁ + ω, ω₁ + ω)² (gchPart4Theory) is syntactically consistent; the stronger simultaneous all-target question ∀ ξ < ω₂, ω₂ → (ξ)²₂ under GCH remains open and is not addressed. For Part (i), erdosproblems.com/1172's cropped-scan binary reconstruction is omitted, and the original un-cropped Baumgartner-Hajnal-Todorčević (1993, p. 2) countable-color question ω₃ → (ω₂ + 2)²_ω under GCH remains open and is not claimed (an unselected remark in Erdos1172/CountableNeighborhoodStep.lean notes that our countable-color neighborhood ideal on ω₃ recovers the known ω₂ + 1 case GCH → ω₃ → (ω₂ + 1)²_ω due to Erdős and Rado, [ErRa56]; [BHT93, Theorem 2.1]).
